title: Arcane Index Reference Manual
summary: Search Arcana pages, discovery states, relations, and optional magic records without relying on JEI.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: Arcane Index is the official magic knowledge browser for Arcana Division. It organizes recipes, research, rituals, spells, relics, curses, machines, mobs, and progression records.

blocks.title: First Steps
blocks.body: Open the Arcane Index before copying a recipe from memory. Search by category, discovery state, relation, or known item to find the current truth.

blocks.title: Core Loop
blocks.body: Find an arcane clue, search its record, follow related links, compare required systems, and return with the exact ritual, spell, relic, or curse context you need.

blocks.title: Important Systems
blocks.body: Categories, entries, relations, discovery states, generated bridge pages, and provider snapshots let Arcane Index stay useful even when JEI or optional magic addons are absent.

blocks.title: Integrations
blocks.body: Arcana Core feeds dynamic records, Grimoire supplies archive context, RelicTech and RitualCore publish starter pages, and Veilbound bridges can generate large reference catalogs safely.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If a page is absent, check the source provider, discovery state, and optional addon. If JEI is missing, Arcane Index should still be the source of truth.
